doc.title: Ray Blue interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 23, 2022

title: First paying gig with the Soul Sextet
summary: His first paid gig was for a night school group led by teacher John Sullivan, with the Soul Sextet.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Do you remember your first paying gig and what you made?

Yes I do remember. One of our strong supporters, an English teacher, Mr. John Sullivan, he ran the night school downstairs in the high school, and he had us come to play for his group. Now we only knew three tunes, starting out. And yeah, we got paid $15 — I think or no, was it six bucks apiece? Yeah, because they took up a collection. Yeah.
You beat me by two dollars. Same situation, like in the high school. That’s great. What was the name of this band?
